mapper.select: SELECT cu.coupon_user_id, cu.user_id, cu.coupon_id, c.name, c.discount_type, c.discount_value, cu.issued_at, cu.used_at, c.valid_to FROM pt_coupon_user cu INNER JOIN pt_coupon c ON cu.coupon_id = c.coupon_id WHERE cu.user_id = #{userId} AND cu.used_at IS NULL AND c.is_active = 1 AND c.valid_to >= NOW() ORDER BY c.valid_to ASC

SELECT cu.coupon_user_id, cu.user_id, cu.coupon_id, c.name, c.discount_type, c.discount_value, cu.issued_at, cu.used_at, c.valid_to FROM pt_coupon_user cu INNER JOIN pt_coupon c ON cu.coupon_id = c.coupon_id WHERE cu.user_id = #{userId} AND cu.coupon_id = #{couponId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pt_coupon_user (coupon_user_id, user_id, coupon_id) VALUES (#{couponUserId}, #{userId}, #{couponId})
